brief:
Israeli forces carried out a controlled explosion between the villages of Miس al-Jabel and Talousah in southern Lebanon, the Ma'an news agency reported. The blast occurred in the border region separating the two communities in the country's south.

No immediate statement explained the military operation or its strategic purpose. The detonation marks another instance of activity by Israeli forces in the area, which has remained a flashpoint for regional tensions and occasional cross-border incidents involving armed groups based in Lebanon.
title: Israeli military detonates explosives between southern Lebanese villages
